name: 数据工程与大数据处理
description: 数据管线的采集、清洗、转换、调度与数据验证；分布式批处理、存储布局、数据湖/仓；消息队列、流处理的事件时间与状态、背压与端到端保证。

sources.title: Data Engineering Zoomcamp (DataTalks.Club) — curriculum, videos, code, homeworks, final project
sources.covers: M1 Containerization & IaC (Docker/Postgres/Terraform), M2 Workflow Orchestration (Kestra: schedule, retry, backfill; dlt ingestion), M3 Data Warehouse (BigQuery partitioning/clustering), M4 Analytics Engineering (dbt staging/intermediate/mart, tests, docs), M5 Batch Processing (Spark/PySpark, Dataproc), M6 Streaming (Kafka, Kafka+Flink, schema registry), final project builds an end-to-end pipeline.
sources.access: Free course docs, module videos (YouTube playlists), GitHub code and homeworks; cloud services used in labs are billed by their own providers. Modules change tools by year (Mage → Kestra).

evidence.location: Curriculum page module list M1–M6 and final project
evidence.finding: The curriculum page lists the six modules with their tools and topics (orchestration, warehouse, dbt, Spark, Kafka/Flink) and the final project requirement.

sources.title: Apache Flink 1.20 Documentation — Timely Stream Processing, Stateful Stream Processing, Checkpointing, Back Pressure
sources.covers: Event time vs processing time, watermarks, state and keyed state, checkpointing and exactly-once recovery, and the back-pressure monitoring page. Supplies the streaming semantics that the Zoomcamp only touches in M6.
sources.access: Free official Apache documentation; versioned docs (1.20) remain online.

evidence.location: Concepts: Timely Stream Processing; Stateful Stream Processing; Checkpointing
evidence.finding: Opened the English time and stateful-processing concept pages; the docs distinguish event/processing time and describe watermarks, state, checkpoints and exactly-once recovery.

监控反压；Checkpointing 与 exactly-once 恢复

topics.note: 端到端 exactly-once 在 Flink 文档里按 source/sink 语义讨论，未覆盖跨系统幂等写入的工程做法。

steps.read: 读第3–4章建立 HDFS/HBase 存储布局，第7、9、10章做一遍 MapReduce→Hive→Spark 的批处理与仓库转换。
读「及时流处理」「有状态流处理」「监控反压」，用 Flink 本地集群跑一个带 Watermark 与 Checkpoint 的窗口作业。
按使用流程走数据集成、作业开发/调度、数据质量规则，理解管线编排与验证的平台形态。
原课程存储/批处理后，读第4章并运行生产者、消费者与CSV→Kafka→MySQL示例，再按第8章做缺失值、日期、文本规范化案例；对照原zh3接回调度和验证。
原Hive仓库章节后理解表格式、快照、演进、ACID和多引擎，说明湖表相对普通Parquet文件多了哪些能力。
跟步骤6–9梳理Catalog→建表→批量写入→MERGE→聚合/元数据；托管执行需自行准备付费集群，本轮仅登记。
Complete M1–M6 in order: containerize Postgres, orchestrate with Kestra + dlt, load BigQuery, model with dbt, run Spark, then Kafka/Flink; finish with the end-to-end project.
Read Timely Stream Processing, Stateful Stream Processing and Checkpointing, then the Back Pressure page, to understand the semantics that M6 demonstrates.
After Zoomcamp M3–M5, run the local Spark/object-store/catalog quickstart, then read Evolution and Reliability; trace a table update through metadata and atomic commit.

findings: 原英文 Zoomcamp 的课程页已核到 M1–M6 与期末项目，采集/转换/调度/批处理/仓库/流处理都有；但湖仓表格式与背压没有专门模块，本次补 Flink 文档覆盖事件时间、状态、checkpoint 与反压。

没有把英文课程当作中文缺口的替代：中文的编排/调度/质量由 DataArts 补，流处理语义由 Flink 中文文档补，剩余缺口如实列出。
